## Lecture concepts

### 1. Organization and function of the central noradrenergic system

NE neurons in the brain are located in the pons and medulla, especially in the locus coeruleus (LC). All neurons in the LC express the enzyme DBH and synthesize NE.

**What to know:**
- NE neurons in the brain are located in the pons and medulla, especially in the locus coeruleus (LC)
- All neurons in the LC express the enzyme DBH and synthesize NE
- Pharmacodynamic profile very similar to dopamine
- Reuptake (NET / DAT)
- Vesicular packaging (VMAT)

**Meyer connection:** Review the chapter discussion of **catecholamine synthesis and the rate-limiting role of tyrosine hydroxylase** and use it to explain the mechanism behind the lecture point rather than memorizing the slide wording alone.

### 3. What is impulsivity

**What to know:**

- Impaired response inhibition/inhibitory control
- Ex.Shouting out the answer
- Cognitive impulsivity (impulsive choice)
- Without forethought – immediate rewards

### 12. Neurobiology of ADHD – seminal PET studies Neurobiologyof ADHD–seminalPETstudies

Reduced dopamine synthesis/activity in mPFCof ADHDpatients (Ernst et al. 1998). Radioactive DOPA.

**What to know:**
- Reduced dopamine synthesis/activity in mPFCof ADHDpatients (Ernst et al. 1998)
- Radioactive DOPA
- Higher dopamine turnover in PFC(anterior cingulate cortex) of un-treated ADHD patients (Ludolph et al. 2008)
- Not found in methylphenidate-treated patients (chronic)
- ADHDcognitive deficits are due to hypo- dopaminergic PFC F18ratio =ratio of radioactive DOPA uptake in region of interest vs.reference region which does not produce much DA ➔Measure of DAsynthesis Ernst et al. 1998

**Meyer connection:** Review the chapter discussion of **nigrostriatal, mesolimbic and mesocortical functions** and use it to explain the mechanism behind the lecture point rather than memorizing the slide wording alone.

### 13. Neurobiologyof ADHD–animalstudies

Methylphenidate: increases dopamine (DA) and noradrenaline (NA) levels in PFC and striatum (dorsal striatum and NAc) (Bymaster et al. 2002). NETinhibitor, atomoxetine:increases DAand NAonly in the PFC(Bymaster et al. 2002) Prefrontal cortex- NA DA.

**What to know:**
- Methylphenidate: increases dopamine (DA) and noradrenaline (NA) levels in PFC and striatum (dorsal striatum and NAc) (Bymaster et al. 2002)
- NETinhibitor, atomoxetine:increases DAand NAonly in the PFC(Bymaster et al. 2002) Prefrontal cortex- NA DA
